g.text: ● Allowed · Low/Med = Low & Medium urgencies only · — Not allowed
Coordinator(s) = staff's assigned coordinators · REJECTED only reachable via HR/Mgmt Accept after review · emails sent on Accept + Override
Rejection flow: pending →(Justified?=No)→ rejection_under_review →(HR/Mgmt review)→ rejected [Accept] OR → IN_PROGRESS directly [Override, rejection_override=true, coord cannot reject again]
Email events: coordinator_rejected (→ Coord+HR+Mgmt) · hr_rejected (→ HR+Mgmt only) · review_accepted (→ Coord+HR+Mgmt) · review_overridden (→ Coord+HR+Mgmt)
